impact: Core defect fixed by T-004 (be56785): padRight/padLeft pad on pyLen() code points (src/format.ts:130-153) and renderTable's rule uses pyLen(hdr) (src/table.ts:28), matching CPython len() including astral and unpaired-surrogate inputs. Pinned against regression by tests-ts/unicode-parity.test.mjs:98-124 (CPython f-string oracle over the shared corpus).
resolution: Fixed in commit be56785 (T-004): padRight/padLeft compute width - pyLen(s) where pyLen counts code points (src/format.ts:130-153, doc comment cites this issue), and renderTable's header rule uses pyLen(hdr) (src/table.ts:28). The differential test this issue requested EXISTS: tests-ts/unicode-parity.test.mjs:98-124 pins pyLen and padRight/padLeft against a CPython f-string oracle over the shared corpus (the triage note claiming it was missing had greped tests/ only; the suite lives in tests-ts/). Verified passing 2026-07-31.
title: padRight/padLeft pad by UTF-16 code units while claiming CPython format-spec semantics
